tooltips.name: OpenCode skill directory name (lowercase, hyphens). Maps to .config/opencode/skills/{name}/SKILL.md
tooltips.description: Shown to the agent when choosing which skill to load (max 1024 chars)
tooltips.body: Markdown instructions (after YAML frontmatter). Frontmatter is edited via Name + Description — Lexical only receives the body. Pasting a full SKILL.md will strip --- yaml --- automatically.
tooltips.workspaceKind: Where this skill lives: CRM Global (admin), Tenant Shared (one edit for all), Membership (AI agent pack), User, or Contact override.
tooltips.targetUserId: Admin-only: CRM User.id when Catalog Scope is User and editing another operator workspace.
tooltips.membershipId: ChatwootAccountUserMembership.id when Catalog Scope is Membership.
tooltips.entityRef: Resolved scope key (user id, membership id, account~contact, or -).
